title: DairyGuard: what a temperature log can and cannot tell about milk spoilage
description: Open code, data and results for DairyGuard: a Monte Carlo benchmark of 240,000 simulated milk deliveries that measures how much prediction accuracy a cold-chain temperature monitor loses to unobserved biology, sensor error, sampling interval and decision rule, with a generalized-time kinetic theory and a calorimetric extension. Full write-up: DairyGuard Technical Report DG-TR-01 (not peer reviewed).
